document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You subsist on the scant provender which you can shoot or 
pick up from the forest. Each day’s walk grows harder than 
the one before.

One  night,  on  Bernard’s  watch,  Norman  shakes  you 
awake. His eyes are wide and fearful. “Professor! Sylvia’s gone! 
And… Bernard...”

Your stomach sinks. Bernard Ebstein’s corpse sprawls by the 
fire. His skull has been shattered; the likely murder weapon, a 
heavy piece of wood, lies discarded beside him. Large tracks in 
the moist earth lead into the darkness.

To follow the tracks, go to 128. To give Sylvia up for lost and try to 
save Norman, go to 279.
